prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” digital marketing agency — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry and preferred working style. A few quick questions will let me recommend agencies that are a good fit:

- What are your top goals? (brand awareness, lead gen, e‑commerce sales, SEO, paid ads, content, social, full service, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual marketing budget?
- Company type/size and industry (startup, SMB, enterprise; SaaS, e‑commerce, local services, etc.)
- Do you prefer a small local agency, a specialty performance shop, or a larger full‑service firm?
- Any requirements: US‑based only, experience with specific ad platforms, EU data rules, timeline?

What to look for when evaluating SF agencies
- Relevant case studies and measurable results for companies like yours
- Clear KPIs and reporting cadence
- Client references you can call
- Certifications/partnerships (Google, Meta, Shopify, HubSpot)
- Team seniority and who will actually do the work
- Pricing model and contract length
- Cultural/communication fit

Where to find vetted options
- Clutch.co, G2, UpCity for reviews and categories
- Google Partners directory for PPC specialists
- LinkedIn and local meetup groups for referrals
- Ask peers/VCs/accelerators for references (they often share trusted vendors)

If you tell me your goals and budget, I’ll shortlist 4–6 San Francisco–area agencies (with strengths, typical pricing ranges, and questions to ask each). Which direction would you like to take?
